answer.location_description: A small patch below and to the right of the image centre, around rows 19-21 and columns 16-19, centred near row 20, columns 17-19. It sits outside the blob region the model uses for size.
answer.shortcut_type: localized bright spot/marker in the lower-right background
answer.mechanism: The layer-1 units fall into two groups. Small-blob detectors (0, 3, 5, 8, 14, 15, 18, 20, 23, 24, 25, 28, 31) have a positive centre, a negative ring and a positive surround. These units carry unusually large positive weights on pixels (20,17-19) and (19,16). Large-blob detectors (1, 6, 9, 10, 12, 16, 27, 30) have a positive ring and a negative centre. These units carry unusually large negative weights on the same pixels. So brightness in this patch excites the small-blob pathway and suppresses the large-blob pathway. The small-blob units feed layer-2 u9, whose output weight is -98 (and similar units such as u3 at -93). The large-blob units feed u4 (output +99). The net effect lowers the logit, pushing toward class 0.
answer.evidence: At pixel (20,19) the weights are 81, 78, 80, 83, 54, 63, 68 and 52 in units 0, 18, 25, 28, 20, 15, 31 and 5, against roughly 0-40 in neighbouring background pixels. At (19,16) they are 58, 64, 66, 55, 70, 67, 84 and 46 in units 0, 3, 8, 14, 15, 20, 23 and 31. In the large-blob units the same pixels are negative: (20,19) is -69 in unit 1, -65 in unit 6, -49 in unit 16 and -46 in unit 12, and -53 at (20,17) in unit 10. (19,16) is -51 in unit 1, -54 in unit 16, -56 in unit 30 and -48 in unit 10. This sign-coordinated, localized deviation appears consistently across about 20 units, far from the blob-size annulus at rows 6-17. Downstream, u9 takes positive weights from the small-blob units and has output weight -98. u4 takes positive weights from units 6, 9, 16 and 30 and has output weight +99.
answer.main_feature: Centre-surround templates. Units with a bright centre and a dark ring at radius about 4-7 pixels signal small blobs. Units with a bright ring and a dark centre, covering roughly rows 6-17 and columns 6-17, signal large blobs.
